defaultSections.body:
Dear {{client_name}},

We are pleased to extend this formal offer of engagement with {{client_company}}. Your skills and background stood out during our evaluation process, and we look forward to welcoming you.

defaultSections.heading: 2. Compensation & Benefits Structure
defaultSections.body: Your total compensation package is {{currency}} {{deal_amount}} per annum / engagement period, structured as detailed in the schedule below.

Educational certificates and prior employment relieving/experience letters.

defaultSections.body: Please sign and return a copy of this document to confirm your acceptance and scheduled start date.
